name: appointment-card
title: Appointment card
description: An upcoming appointment at a glance: a date leaf, the time and its length, who and where, a status badge, and actions to reschedule, cancel or add to a calendar.
docs: start and end are exact moments (a Date, a timestamp or an ISO string with its offset); timeZone is where the appointment takes place and every time on the card is written in it (Thu, Nov 5, 2026 and 10:00 AM – 10:45 AM · 45 min). readerTimeZone is the zone of the person looking: when its clock tells another time the card names the zone (10:00 – 10:45 GMT-5), and without it the card reads the browser zone after the first paint. status is confirmed, pending or cancelled; an appointment whose end has passed (against now, or the browser clock) mutes and says Completed (Expired when it was never confirmed). location.url makes it an Online appointment with a Join video call link while it is still to come, location.address an On site one. actions: onReschedule adds a button; onCancel adds a Cancel appointment entry in a menu that asks first in a dialog whose safe answer has the focus, shows a busy state while your promise runs and stays open with a message when it rejects, and once it resolves the card shows itself cancelled; calendar (default true) adds Add to calendar built from the appointment. labels carries every word, with {title}, {person} and {date} filled in.
